title: S1 · Datos base Delivery60 (Config, Enums, PackageTypes, Destinations)
request: Sprint 1, comando 2/8 del plan de desarrollo de DELIVERY: 60 SECONDS (Notion: Plan §6). Crea los ModuleScript de datos: Config, Enums, PackageTypes (Normal/Heavy/Explosive) y Destinations, y verifica cada uno con inspect_instance.

operations.source:
-- Config · Datos de diseño globales de DELIVERY: 60 SECONDS (S1)
-- Fuente: GDD en Notion. Valores marcados [CALIBRAR] son defaults de partida, no canon.
local Config = {
	-- Reglas del core (canon del GDD)
	DeliveryTimeSeconds = 60, -- GDD §1: cada entrega dura 60 s
	BasePay = 100, -- GDD §13: Base Pay +100
	SpeedBonusMax = 50, -- GDD §13: Speed Bonus +50
	PerfectBonus = 100, -- GDD §13/§14: Perfect Delivery +100
	ConsolationPay = 100, -- GDD §38: fallo → 100 coins de consolación

	-- Movimiento (S1: normal + sprint) [CALIBRAR]
	WalkSpeed = 16, -- default de Roblox
	SprintSpeed = 24, -- [CALIBRAR] aprox. 1.5x
	StaminaMax = 100, -- [CALIBRAR]
	StaminaDrainPerSecond = 20, -- [CALIBRAR]
	StaminaRegenPerSecond = 15, -- [CALIBRAR]
}

return Config

-- PackageTypes · Catálogo base del MVP (GDD §40): Normal, Heavy, Explosive.
-- Los paquetes referencian modificadores por id; los modificadores viven en
-- ReplicatedStorage.Delivery60.Modifiers (registro con interfaz común, plan §4).
local PackageTypes = {
	Normal = {
		id = "Normal",
		displayName = "Normal",
		icon = "📦",
		stars = 1,
		payMultiplier = 1.0, -- canon GDD §5
		modifiers = {},
	},
	Heavy = {
		id = "Heavy",
		displayName = "Heavy",
		icon = "🐌",
		stars = 2,
		payMultiplier = 2.0, -- canon GDD §5: recompensa x2
		modifiers = { "Heavy" },
	},
	Explosive = {
		id = "Explosive",
		displayName = "Explosive",
		icon = "💣",
		stars = 2,
		payMultiplier = 3.0, -- canon GDD §5: paga x3
		modifiers = { "Explosive" },
	},
}

return PackageTypes
